issues.issue: Same label/money is categorized differently in one report: the governmental funds statement (p4) prints General Fund 'Local' 26,182,458 under the Intergovernmental heading and receipts[3] records it as intergovernmental/state aid, but the budget-schedule 'Local' lines are in other. 'Local' is a context label (category_decision cites the label file). Also applies to detail[72] (Special Roads Local 5,358,018, p10) and detail[91] (nonmajor Local 3,608,562, p12).

ARPA object lines use inconsistent function categories: Supplies and materials -> 'Supplies and Materials', Operating expenses -> 'Operating', but Equipment and office rental -> 'other' (the business-type rental line uses 'Rent/Leases'). Category 'other' where a specific one fits.
ARPA operating expenses 200,000 equal the ARPA column's 'Public welfare and social services' 200,000 on the governmental funds statement (p4); the function could be health/welfare.
Same label 'Operating expenses' gets detail_category 'not itemized' in the ARPA schedule (detail[83]) but 'Other / Miscellaneous Expenses' here. Inconsistent.
Keno fund spending is in 'other'. The function isn't printed, but keno proceeds usually fund Community Betterment. This is a judgment call.
A large line (half of nonmajor spending) is in 'other'. The sinking fund's purpose isn't printed. It could be capital outlay or debt service, so it needs review.

issues.extracted: Capital Assets - Depreciable - Net of Depreciation
issues.issue: The printed line is GROSS depreciable assets. Accumulated depreciation is printed and recorded separately (assets[23] -98,923,061), so the 'Net of Depreciation' label is wrong for this amount. Same for assets[22] (business-type 48,252,125). Land and Work in Progress were not renamed to 'Capital Assets - Non-Depreciable'.
ending_cash is the combined printed 'Cash and investments' line, which includes restricted cash held in escrow (GW restricted cash 104,622,215). It is not cash alone, and ending_investments is null.
Printed under the Public Safety heading and recorded as debt service. This is defensible because the label says bonds, but it is a judgment call.
